facts.business: Prime Focus Limited is a global visual effects and animation services company with a significant investment in DNEG S.a.r.l.

auditor.name: M S K A & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on insolvency proceedings against the Company stayed by NCLAT and sub-judice (Note 42(iii)(a))

key_risks: Insolvency proceedings initiated by RASPL under IBC, currently stayed by NCLAT and sub-judice
Impairment evaluation of significant investment in DNEG S.a.r.l. (INR 7,076.40 Crore) involving estimation uncertainty
Contingent liabilities for income tax (INR 5.24 Crore) and GST matters (INR 2.67 Crore) under appeals
Legal disputes related to Business Transfer Agreement with Reliance MediaWorks and Loan Agreement with RASPL
facts.related_party_note: Preferential issue of 46,26,68,572 equity shares at INR 120 per share approved by Members at EGM on July 26, 2025; allotment on September 17 and 23, 2025. Company acquired FMS business from Reliance MediaWorks in 2014 with remaining consideration structured as debt to RASPL.
